subject: Hospitality
title: Anthony Melchiorri: Hotel Rescue Expert
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Anthony Melchiorri: Hotel Rescue Expert.

hook.text: Anthony Melchiorri hosted 'Hotel Impossible'—rescuing failing hotels on TV. But his real expertise is operational turnarounds.

buildup.text: Melchiorri managed the Algonquin Hotel in New York. He revived it by honoring its literary history while modernizing operations.

discovery.text: His approach: fix the basics first—cleanliness, staff training, guest follow-up. Glamour means nothing without clean rooms.

twist.text: Most failing hotels don't have exotic problems. They fail because owners skip fundamentals: maintenance, training.

climax.text: Melchiorri democratized hotel management knowledge through TV. Millions learned hospitality basics from prime-time television.

punchline.text: Clean rooms, trained staff, accountability. Hotel success is unglamorous.

quiz.question: What is Anthony Melchiorri's core message about failing hotels?
options: Most fail because they skip fundamentals like cleanliness and training
